# Creative Spirits

> A comprehensive educational resource for learning and teaching Australian Aboriginal culture, history, and contemporary issues.

Creative Spirits provides evidence-based information on Aboriginal Australian peoples, covering cultural practices, historical events, social issues, and educational resources. The site serves educators, students, and anyone seeking to understand Aboriginal culture and address misconceptions.

## Key Topics

- Aboriginal culture
- Aboriginal history
- Indigenous Australia
- Stolen Generations
- Aboriginal land rights
- Aboriginal education
- Aboriginal health
- Dreaming (Dreamtime)
- Uluru Statement from the Heart
- Aboriginal languages
- Aboriginal spirituality
- Welcome to Country
- Aboriginal self-determination
- NAIDOC
- Cultural sensitivity

## Core Resources

- [Helping you learn and teach about Aboriginal culture](https://creativespirits.info): Creative Spirits homepage: Learn and teach Aboriginal culture with resources
- [Start exploring Australian Aboriginal culture](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture): Aboriginal culture guide: Facts, statistics, and contemporary information
- [Teacher & student resources](https://creativespirits.info/resources): Educational resources: Teaching tools, infographics, films, curriculum support

## Culture & Spirituality

- [Aboriginal spirituality and beliefs](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/spirituality): Aboriginal spirituality: Beliefs, Dreaming, ceremonies, cultural protocols
- [Aboriginal arts](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/arts): Aboriginal arts guide: Traditional and contemporary art, poetry, dot paintings
- [Aboriginal languages](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/language): Aboriginal languages: Facts, statistics, preservation, translation issues

## History & Society

- [Australian Aboriginal history](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/history): Aboriginal history: Searchable timeline, significant events, cultural facts
- [Aboriginal people in Australia](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/people): Aboriginal people: Population, statistics, identity, health, racism, stereotypes
- [Aboriginal land and land rights](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/land): Aboriginal land rights: Meaning, history, ownership, legal claims
- [Aboriginal self-determination and autonomy](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/selfdetermination): Aboriginal self-determination: Autonomy, sovereignty, treaties, timeline

## Social Issues & Disparities

- [Aboriginal health](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/health): Aboriginal health: Issues, statistics, disparities, and historical factors
- [Aboriginal education](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/education): Aboriginal education: Problems, statistics, literacy rates, improvements
- [Aboriginal law & justice](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/law): Aboriginal justice: Incarceration rates, customary law, sentencing disparities
- [Aboriginal economy](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/economy): Aboriginal economy: Stolen wages, financial literacy, business opportunities

## Politics & Media

- [Aboriginal politics](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/politics): Aboriginal politics: Stolen Generations, politicians, intervention, flag
- [Aboriginal topics in the media](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/media): Aboriginal media: Coverage, journalist tips, terminology, social media use

## Learning Materials

- [Infographics about Aboriginal culture](https://creativespirits.info/resources/infographics): Aboriginal infographics: Visual learning resources for NAIDOC, reconciliation
- [Best books about Aboriginal culture](https://creativespirits.info/resources/books): Aboriginal book database: Search, reviews, educational and literature resources

## Optional

- [Aboriginal sport](https://creativespirits.info/aboriginalculture/sport): Aboriginal sport: History, traditional games, AFL/NRL statistics, athletes
